## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive — broad internal strength despite mixed risk signals. VXX (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) BELOW TREND confirms fear easing and SPY_TLT flat (Stocks vs Bonds 1W: -1.00% | 1M: -2.50% → flat) shows neutral positioning, producing the cautionary mix.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress easing: HYG (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND — HYG/LQD rising (↑) points to easier credit. Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds neutral (→ flat) limits a clean risk-on signal.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Yield curve steepening: Yield Curve (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +2.61%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, while TLT (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND keeps duration favored. Dollar in CORRECTION: UUP (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION, leaving conditions mildly easier but mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Semis and Tech leading: SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing strength: XLF (1W: +2.89% | 1M: +5.54%) ABOVE TREND. Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND — style: Growth/Tech tilt but breadth supports cyclicals too.

5. US vs Global?  
US broad market in RECOVERY: SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY, while Emerging Markets outperformed this week: EEM (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.76%) RECOVERY — global strength is selective but meaningful.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculative flows mixed: IBIT (1W: +5.57% | 1M: -20.12%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -3.07%) RECOVERY show episodic risk-on interest, while the Speculation Index (1W: -0.64% | 1M: +0.65% → flat) is subdued.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Copper showing reflation tilt: CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY and Copper/Gold ratio ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; Gold under pressure: GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND, signaling lower precious-metal risk bid.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy weakening: BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND, while natural gas in CORRECTION: UNG (1W: -2.74% | 1M: +3.37%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +2.89% | 1M: +5.54%) ABOVE TREND show sector-level confirmation; DIVERGENCE: SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY and several industry ETFs (CIBR 1W: -1.58% | 1M: +12.50% CORRECTION; SKYY 1W: -4.79% | 1M: +6.69% CORRECTION) highlight short-term rotation risk.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to semiconductors and tech strength (SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND; XLK ABOVE TREND) and small-cap participation (IWM (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +3.64%) ABOVE TREND), while reducing exposure to energy risk (XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND) and monitoring gold (GLD BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Semiconductors SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND and Financials XLF (1W: +2.89% | 1M: +5.54%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND and Oil BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY linked to industrial demand.  
BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND and Brent BNO BELOW TREND remain downside risks.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 24.2 (VXX (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) BELOW TREND) as complacency watch, HYG/LQD ratio ~0.7333 (Credit Spread 1W: -0.37% | 1M: -0.33% → flat) for credit health, XLK/XLF 3.4646 (Tech vs Financials 1W: -2.24% | 1M: +0.44% ↓ falling) as leadership pivot, and SPY recovery threshold near short-term support (SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, creating a mixed picture of strong internals with lingering risk signals. Semiconductors and Tech (SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND) and Small Caps (IWM (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +3.64%) ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength. Key risk: SPY RECOVERY divergence (SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY) and falling gold GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND to monitor.
